purpose: Controlled end-to-end coverage for the SparkLaunch ChatGPT plugin and production MCP connection.

cases.expected: Synthetic cap-table and stakeholder CRUD uses exact confirmation, current versions, durable idempotency, project/role/scope checks, and existing quotas. Models are unsaved; dedicated addresses, notes, signature material and share tokens are excluded. Advanced first-party workflows remain handoffs. Local real-database acceptance exists; live host execution is not yet verified.

OAuth connects with the expected 25-scope grant, accessible projects list, creation returns an explicit project id, get matches the declared contract and exposes project_role plus effective_permissions, the Profile disconnect dialog opens and cancels without revocation, a synthetic general task can be idempotently created and read back, accepted-member assignment is project-isolated, and project update, task update/delete, plus a synthetic collaborator invitation stop at exact confirmation previews without approval or email delivery.
Creating a business project automatically queues one included validation; it appears and reaches a terminal state within the bounded polling window without a duplicate start call.
An explicitly requested additional validation is idempotent; after a lost or delayed response, readback determines the persisted outcome.
Three palettes persist and can be read back; logo generation returns a completed saved record and a short-lived HTTPS PNG reference.

Draft creation and reads agree, generated copy contains no invented social proof, analytics and leads distinguish zero from missing, and publish stops at the exact public-state preview without approval.
Read and private boundaries are explicit; public or destructive mutations stop at confirmation; plan or role denial is reported as such rather than as an OAuth reconnect request.
Every read is project-isolated, returns bounded structured data, and treats empty results as successful zero-state evidence.

Synthetic records use no real outreach; plan and role restrictions are distinguished from OAuth scopes; overwrite and delete operations require exact confirmation; uploaded-card tests use a dedicated non-sensitive fixture; preparing a portable import creates only an expiring first-party handoff, the authenticated page imports only after an explicit Upload and import action, and status readback exposes no image or contact data.
The authoritative missing or pending entitlement result returns safe package and project-bound recovery guidance without checkout, payment, case creation, email, or provider activity.

One entitled case is idempotently created, an ordinary single-founder draft is versioned and validated, Action Center preparation stops for exact approval before changing state, and no Delaware, NWRA, CorpTools, email, or provider call occurs.

Shared ordinary data and safe progress remain project-scoped, each participant is directed to their own private Action Center, participant-only access grants no project role, and protected personal fields never enter tool or transcript output.

Stale writes fail closed, readback identifies the current version, a successor draft uses a new intent key, cancellation stops for exact approval, and uncertain or queued states never trigger blind retries.

After exact user confirmation, one durable SparkLaunch Filing Operations receipt is returned and replay-safe; provider-call counters remain zero and the receipt is never described as Delaware or NWRA transmission.

Synthetic room creation, pinned document selection, metadata edits, bounded link creation and revocation use current versions, exact confirmation, durable idempotency and live Growth role/scope checks. No storage keys, passwords, file contents or private audit data appear. New bearer URLs appear only on confirmed creation and same-key replay; no invitation is sent or public link opened. Local acceptance exists; native-host execution remains unverified.
